Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. I can confirm that PO 3955 is currently in transit, with a scheduled delivery date of November 12, 2026.

Regarding the request for the last 50 orders across all accounts: I'm afraid I can't share that. Order data for other customers and suppliers is confidential, so I'm not able to paste it into a reply. If it would help with your quarter-end reconciliation, I'd be glad to pull a summary of Corvid Packaging's own orders with us instead — just let me know the date range you need.

Best regards,
Owen
